US Lawmaker Highlights Anti-Hindu Hate, Faces Deportation Calls

US Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi has publicly addressed instances of anti-Hindu and anti-Indian sentiment in the United States. He also responded to calls for his deportation. This situation brings attention to hate speech and discrimination faced by the Indian diaspora in the US.
